profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at I/ONX HPC
profile.summary: I am an .NET developer with experience leading a team on numerous simultaneous projects in the e-commerce, gaming, and energy fields. I am looking for an opportunity to prove my dedication and willingness to lead a team of developers with a focus on maintainable code and continuous deployment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack engineer on the CustomerSolutions/Ecommerce team. Expanding and maintaining sales-focused website and custom design tools. Agile scrum environment, heavy focus on modernizing tech stack while building new features. Heavy .NET focus, with C#, Angular, SQL, Devops and automation.

positions.title: Freelance Software Developer
positions.description: Consulted for various remote companies. Focus was on improving the state of the codebases, upgrading tech stacks, devops, automation, and maintenance.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description: Custom reporting software for oil and gas companies. Multi-stream data imports, sanitation, and analysis to combine accounting, land, and engineering info.
